title: Inspect and extend: A wallet screen is a view of money records
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/data.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve transaction shape, satoshi formatting, seeded records, and tab shell.
problem: A wallet dashboard is a summary board. Learn the Transaction record and satoshi units, then trace the sample rows and balance display into the screen. Separate sample values from values supplied by a network. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/data.ts` and the related project files: src/data.ts; src/screens/WalletScreen.tsx; src/components.tsx; src/theme.ts; App.tsx.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to transaction shape, satoshi formatting, seeded records, and tab shell.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Seed transactions and the receive address are placeholders; never send funds to them.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A wallet dashboard is a summary board. Learn the Transaction record and satoshi units, then trace the sample rows and balance display into the screen. Separate sample values from values supplied by a network.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/data.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
